label: Matt 20:1
text: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

label: Matt 20:2
text:
When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius
a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

label: Matt 20:3
text:
He went out about the third hour,
and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

variants.note: The fetched Wikipedia 'Textual variants in the Gospel of Matthew' lists 'ευρεν (found) — D 1424 it(mss)' against 'ειδεν (saw) — rell' for Matthew 20:3. The WEB reads 'saw'; D and 1424 are not manuscript nodes of this graph.

label: Matt 20:4
text: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

label: Matt 20:5
text:
Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour,
and did likewise.

label: Matt 20:6
text:
About the eleventh hour
he went out, and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

label: Matt 20:7
text:
“They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’
“He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

label: Matt 20:8
text: When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

label: Matt 20:9
text: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

label: Matt 20:10
text: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

label: Matt 20:11
text: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

label: Matt 20:12
text: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us, who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

label: Matt 20:13
text: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

label: Matt 20:14
text: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

label: Matt 20:15
text: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

label: Matt 20:16
text: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

variants.reading: Short reading: 'So the last will be first, and the first last.' (the saying 'for many are called, but few are chosen' omitted)
variants.note: The fetched Wikipedia variants article lists 'πρωτοι εσχατοι (the first, last) — א B L Z 085 ...' against the longer 'the first, last; for many are called, but few chosen — C D E F G H K M N ...'. The WEB has the longer reading.

variants.reading: Reversed order 'the last first, and the first last' with the saying, in later witnesses
variants.note: The article lists the reversed-order longer text for the majority tradition; those witnesses are not manuscript nodes of this graph.

label: Matt 20:17
text: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

label: Matt 20:18
text: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

label: Matt 20:19
text: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

variants.reading: αναστησεται ('he will be stood upright') instead of 'he will be raised up'
variants.note: The fetched Wikipedia variants article lists 'αναστησεται (he will be stood upright) — B C(c) D E G H K M S U W X Y Γ Δ Θ Π Ω 085 f1 f13 ...' against 'εγερθησεται (he will be raised) — א C* L N Z 579 892 it Origen'. The WEB reads 'he will be raised up'.
Listed for א C* L N Z 579 892 it Origen; the other witnesses are not manuscript nodes of this graph.

label: Matt 20:20
text: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

label: Matt 20:21
text:
He said to her,
“What do you want?”
She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand, and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

label: Matt 20:22
text:
But Jesus answered,
“You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”
They said to him, “We are able.”

variants.reading: The baptism clause omitted: 'Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink?'
variants.note: The fetched Wikipedia variants article lists 'text omitted — א B D L Z Θ 085 1 22 372 788 1582* 2737 lat syr(s,c) cop ... Diatessaron Ambrose Jerome Augustine' for 'και το βαπτισμα ο εγω βαπτιζομαι βαπτισθηναι' at Matthew 20:22. The WEB includes the clause.

variants.reading: 'and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with' present (the WEB text)
variants.note: Listed for S 2 118 157 556 892 1071 1582(mg) ... and later tradition; not manuscript nodes of this graph.

label: Matt 20:23
text:
He said to them,
“You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with, but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

label: Matt 20:24
text: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

label: Matt 20:25
text:
But Jesus summoned them, and said,
“You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

label: Matt 20:26
text:
It shall not be so among you, but whoever desires to become great among you shall be
your servant.

label: Matt 20:27
text: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

label: Matt 20:28
text: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

variants.reading: A long addition after 'many' (parallel to Luke 14:8-10, on seeking the lower place at a dinner)
variants.note: The fetched Wikipedia variants article lists the long addition 'πολλων υμεις δε ζητειτε εκ μικρου αυξησαι ...' for 'D it(a,aur,b,c,d,e,ff1,ff2,g2,h,n,r1,r2) vg(mss) syr(p(mg),h(mg))' at Matthew 20:28. The WEB has the short text.

label: Matt 20:29
text: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

label: Matt 20:30
text: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

label: Matt 20:31
text: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

label: Matt 20:32
text:
Jesus stood still, and called them, and asked,
“What do you want me to do for you?”

label: Matt 20:33
text: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

label: Matt 20:34
text: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.
